decisions.reason: Because it remained on the website from 2023 to 2024, management would read it as at least meeting a minimum aspiration level, but its lower-profile presentation makes it more exposed to portfolio pruning than the other launches.
Its own product page in both years signals continuing commitment and results that are likely close enough to aspirations for a large German machinery firm to keep it on the market.
Like Product B, it kept a dedicated page across two years, so under bounded rationality and with organisational slack the firm would likely continue it while learning more about demand.
Being shown on the home page in its launch year suggests strategic importance and early support, which would place it above the threshold for immediate withdrawal.
A newly launched product with its own page and explicit 'New' positioning would normally be given time to prove itself, especially in a large established firm with slack.
The product is still mentioned on the website and has a cited trade-fair award, which would raise aspirations about its prospects and make withdrawal very unlikely in the coming year.
